# GAOS v1.0.2 — adaptive speech input boundaries

This compatible patch adds `@yugao-gaos/gaos-sdk/speech-input`, a browser-safe,
transport-neutral segmenter for hands-free voice products. It emits the same
start/end boundaries as push-to-talk, supports a product-selected release tail,
and uses a separate assistant-playback gate to reject ordinary speaker echo
without removing deliberate barge-in.

Existing v1.0 callers require no changes.
